schemes.name: 401(k) / 403(b) Employer Retirement Plan
schemes.description: Tax-advantaged employer-sponsored retirement account. Traditional contributions reduce current year taxable income; Roth contributions grow tax-free.

schemes.name: Roth Individual Retirement Account (Roth IRA)
schemes.tax_treatment: Post-Tax Contributions, 100% Tax-Free Qualified Growth & Withdrawals
schemes.formula: TaxFreeFutureValue = Principal * (1 + r)^n + AnnualContribution * (((1 + r)^n - 1) / r)
schemes.description: The gold standard for individual wealth accumulation in the US. Earnings grow completely tax-free and withdrawals after age 59.5 are 100% exempt from federal and state income tax.

schemes.name: Health Savings Account (HSA)
schemes.tax_treatment: Triple Tax-Advantaged (Tax-deductible contribution, Tax-free growth, Tax-free medical withdrawal)
schemes.description: Widely recognized by US wealth planners as the ultimate investment vehicle. Functions as a medical account before age 65, and converts to a traditional retirement account (no medical penalty) after age 65.

schemes.name: 529 Qualified College Savings Plan
schemes.tax_treatment: Post-Tax Contribution, Federal & State Tax-Free Qualified Education Distributions
schemes.description: State-sponsored education savings vehicle. Withdrawals for tuition, room, board, and books are 100% tax-free. Unused balances up to $35,000 can be rolled over to the beneficiary's Roth IRA.
